en.headline: Housing Society raises rents 2.85% from October at most rental estates
en.dek: Category A tenants will pay about HK$73 more on average each month and Category B tenants about HK$200 more; the new levels run until September 2028.

zh.headline: 房協出租屋邨十月起加租2.85% 甲乙類平均月租增73至200元
zh.dek: 新租金由10月1日起生效至2028年9月30日，近兩年新入伙四個屋邨不在今次檢討範圍內。

en.headline: Fish raft fire in Sai Kung’s Po Toi O injures man; vessels damaged
en.dek: A blaze at fish rafts near the minibus stop this morning produced explosions and thick smoke; firefighters and a fireboat extinguished it within about 50 minutes.

zh.headline: 西貢布袋澳魚排起火傳爆炸聲 一人手指受傷
zh.dek: 今早布袋澳一號及二號魚排起火，曾傳出爆炸聲及冒出濃煙，消防水陸兩路灌救，約50分鐘救熄，一名六旬男子救火時手指受傷。

en.headline: Police and Immigration arrest 19 mainland women in Yuen Long anti-prostitution operation
en.dek: Officers from the Yuen Long Police District Special Duties Squad and the Immigration Department detained the women, aged 21 to 51, for alleged breach of conditions of stay during a joint operation on Tuesday.

zh.headline: 元朗掃黃聯同入境處拘19名內地女子 涉違反逗留條件
zh.dek: 元朗警區特別職務隊聯同入境事務處周二展開行動，以涉嫌違反逗留條件拘捕19名年齡介乎21至51歲的內地女子，全部被扣留調查。

en.headline: Customs and Immigration run cross-department drill at new Huanggang Port
en.dek: About 50 officers from Customs, Immigration, police, the Department of Health and the Government Property Agency practised vehicle and passenger clearance procedures, including system faults and reverse exits, ahead…

zh.headline: 新皇崗口岸跨部門通關演練 模擬系統故障及倒車離場
zh.dek: 海關、入境處、警務處、衞生署及政府產業署約50人周二在港方口岸區演練人車通關程序，包括查驗系統故障及車輛倒車離開聯合一站式車道等突發情况。

en.headline: Baptist University reviews systems after ransomware group claims breach
en.dek: The university said it is examining IT security and personal data protection following online claims by the group The Gentlemen that credentials linked to about 1,900 accounts may have been compromised.

zh.headline: 浸大檢視系統保安 勒索軟件組織聲稱入侵
zh.dek: 校方表示正密切檢視資訊科技系統及個人資料安全，有平台指約1,900組與浸大網域相關的憑證可能外洩。

en.headline: CFS urges public not to consume two Olitalia olive oil products
en.dek: The Centre for Food Safety said the Italian pomace olive oils may contain mineral oil hydrocarbons after a Belgian alert; the local distributor has stopped sales and begun a recall.

zh.headline: 食安中心籲勿食用兩款Olitalia橄欖油 或含礦物油
zh.dek: 中心指意大利品牌兩款果渣橄欖油可能含芳香族碳氫化合物，分銷商已停售下架並展開回收。

en.headline: HKBU investigating reports of ransomware group and leaked credentials
en.dek: Security platforms listed Hong Kong Baptist University among victims of the group TheGentlemen, with roughly 1,900 sets of credentials reportedly exposed involving staff and student accounts.

zh.headline: 浸大調查勒索軟件組織聲稱入侵及憑證外洩報告
zh.dek: 網絡安全平台列出浸會大學為勒索軟件組織TheGentlemen聲稱受害者，約1,900組與hkbu.edu.hk相關憑證據報外洩，涉及職員及學生帳戶。

en.headline: Shui Pin Wai Estate hit by second power cut within 18 hours
en.dek: CLP Power said temporary cables caused unstable supply affecting about 2,200 households for roughly 30 minutes on Tuesday night; fire services handled lift entrapment reports.

zh.headline: 水邊圍邨18小時內兩度停電 臨時電纜供電不穩
zh.dek: 中電指周二晚臨時電纜線路懷疑供電不穩，影響約2,200戶約半小時；消防接獲困𨋢報告。

en.headline: Very Hot Weather Warning remains in force as extreme heat continues
en.dek: The Observatory expects mainly fine and very hot conditions on Wednesday, with urban highs around 34 degrees Celsius and some New Territories areas still extremely hot.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣警告仍然生效 今日繼續酷熱
zh.dek: 天文台料星期三大致天晴，日間酷熱，市區最高氣溫約34度，新界部分地區仍然極端酷熱。

en.headline: Universal Funeral Parlour limited to partial service after power fault
en.dek: Tung Wah Group of Hospitals said a busbar and fuse failure at the Hung Hom parlour left some floors without full air-conditioning and lighting; full operations are expected to resume on Thursday afternoon.

zh.headline: 寰宇殯儀館電力故障僅限有限度服務 料周四復常
zh.dek: 東華三院指紅磡寰宇殯儀館二樓電表房滙流排及保險絲故障，部分樓層冷氣及照明受影響，殮房正常，預計周四下午全面修復。

en.headline: 72-year-old hiker found dead on Sha Tin trail after three-day search
en.dek: Rescuers located the body of Tam Hing-man on a mountain path in Man Hang, Fo Tan, on Tuesday morning; he had gone missing while hiking on Saturday.

zh.headline: 72歲行山客沙田失蹤三日後尋回遺體
zh.dek: 搜救人員周二上午在火炭蚊坑山路發現譚姓男子倒卧，當場證實死亡；他周六行山時與同伴走失後失聯。

en.headline: Search under way for passenger missing from Shekou sightseeing boat near HZMB
en.dek: Hong Kong marine police, fireboats and a Government Flying Service helicopter joined the search in waters west of Tuen Mun after the man was noticed missing on the return to Shenzhen.

zh.headline: 港珠澳大橋觀光船疑有乘客墮海 屯門海域搜救中
zh.dek: 深圳蛇口出發的觀光船回程發現一名男乘客失蹤，香港水警、滅火輪及飛行服務隊直升機在屯門后海灣一帶搜索。

en.headline: School flu vaccine outreach switches to electronic consent forms from 17 August
en.dek: Parents can submit consent via the eHealth app by scanning a school-specific QR code, streamlining paperwork for the 2026/27 Seasonal Influenza Vaccination School Outreach Programme.

zh.headline: 流感疫苗學校外展計劃下周一起推電子同意書
zh.dek: 家長可由8月17日起經醫健通掃描學校專屬二維碼為子女遞交接種同意書，簡化填表及行政程序。

en.headline: Police arrest 10 for dangerous driving after first drone operation on Kwun Tong Bypass
en.dek: Nine men and a woman aged 25 to 51 were detained between 3 and 10 August; officers seized seven private cars and three motorcycles in the East Kowloon operation.

zh.headline: 警首次用無人機打擊觀塘繞道危駕 拘10人扣10車
zh.dek: 東九龍交通部3日至10日行動中，9男1女年齡25至51歲涉危險駕駛被捕，扣留7輛私家車及3輛電單車。

en.headline: 18-month-old in serious condition with influenza A and encephalopathy
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a severe paediatric case; the previously healthy boy remains in intensive care at Queen Elizabeth Hospital after developing convulsions.

zh.headline: 18個月大男嬰染甲流併發腦病變及敗血性休克 情况嚴重
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心正調查一宗兒童甲型流感嚴重個案，男嬰過往健康良好，現於伊利沙伯醫院兒童深切治療部留醫。

en.headline: International oil painting exchange exhibition opens at Central Library
en.dek: The second Hong Kong–Beijing–Moscow–St Petersburg–Paris International Oil Painting Exchange Exhibition runs from 11 to 16 August, featuring more than 240 works by local and overseas artists.

zh.headline: 國際油畫交流大展中央圖書館揭幕
zh.dek: 第二屆香港—北京—莫斯科—聖彼得堡—巴黎國際油畫交流大展今日起至16日在中央圖書館舉行，展出超過240幅本地及海外作品。

en.headline: Privacy watchdog arrests man for alleged doxxing over restaurant debt dispute
en.dek: A 37-year-old wholesale food supplier is suspected of disclosing personal details of a former restaurant operator and consultant online after a payment dispute, the Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data…

zh.headline: 私隱專員公署拘男子涉因食肆欠款糾紛起底
zh.dek: 一名37歲凍肉批發商涉嫌在網上披露前餐廳東主及顧問的個人資料，私隱專員公署表示案件源於一宗付款爭議。

en.headline: Taxi collides with police car in Kwai Chung, three injured
en.dek: The taxi driver and two officers reported injuries after the crash at the junction of Kwai Fuk Road and Shing Fuk Street on Monday night; all were conscious.

zh.headline: 葵涌的士攔腰撞警車 三人受傷送院
zh.dek: 周一晚葵福路與盛福街交界發生交通意外，的士司機及兩名警員報稱受傷，全部清醒送院，警方正調查成因。

en.headline: Underground cable fault leaves 2,400 Yuen Long households without power
en.dek: CLP Power said a fault at about 4.22am affected Shui Pin Wai Estate and nearby areas; engineers aimed to restore supply by 10am using temporary generators and cables.

zh.headline: 元朗地底電纜故障 水邊圍邨約2400戶停電
zh.dek: 中電指凌晨約4時22分發生故障，影響水邊圍邨及附近用戶，工程人員調動臨時發電機及電纜搶修，料上午10時復電。

en.headline: Labour chief says heat-stress warning thresholds under review after record heat
en.dek: Commissioner for Labour Chris Hui admitted the system failed to escalate beyond amber during the recent extreme temperatures and pledged faster adjustments, possibly within the summer.

zh.headline: 許澤森：工作暑熱警告門檻將檢視 望暑假內完成
zh.dek: 勞工處處長承認近日破紀錄高溫下警告未有升級，自己亦有問號，正聯同天文台研究下調門檻或引入多軌制，冀今個夏天完成。

en.headline: Foreign man injured in knife attack in Lok Ma Chau
en.dek: A 29-year-old man was wounded in the leg by two assailants on Monday night; police are searching for the suspects and have classified the case as wounding.

zh.headline: 落馬洲外籍男子遭刀襲 腿部受傷
zh.dek: 29歲外籍男子周一晚在落馬洲金博路西被兩人持刀襲擊，腿部受傷，清醒送往博愛醫院，案件列傷人，警方正緝捕疑犯。

en.headline: Michelle Wai wins Best Actress at Hundred Flowers Awards for The Last Dance
en.dek: The Hong Kong actress took the prize in Beijing on Monday for her role in the funeral-industry drama, ahead of mainland competitors.

zh.headline: 衛詩雅憑《破·地獄》奪百花獎最佳女主角
zh.dek: 香港女演員衛詩雅周一在北京第38屆大眾電影百花獎憑本地電影《破·地獄》奪最佳女主角，票數領先內地對手。

en.headline: Japanese tourist robbed of HK$15,000 in Tsim Sha Tsui hotel room
en.dek: A 19-year-old woman was attacked after opening her door at The Imperial Hotel on Monday night; the suspect fled and no arrests have been made.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀酒店日籍女遊客遭搶 損失1.5萬元
zh.dek: 19歲日本女子周一晚在帝豪酒店房門被襲，頸部受傷，約1.5萬元現金被搶，疑犯逃走，暫無人被捕。

en.headline: Remand prisoner attacks staff at Tai Lam Centre for Women; both injured
en.dek: A 35-year-old woman held on remand for possessing Part I poison allegedly assaulted a correctional officer in a reception room on Monday afternoon; both were taken to hospital.

zh.headline: 大欖女懲教所還押女子襲擊職員 雙方受傷送院
zh.dek: 一名35歲因管有第I部毒藥罪還押的女子周一在收押室突然情緒失控襲擊懲教人員，雙方均受傷送院。

en.headline: Customs seizes 4kg of suspected cannabis buds at airport, arrests mainland man
en.dek: A 28-year-old mainland passenger arriving from Bangkok was arrested after officers found about 4 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds worth an estimated HK$900,000 in his checked luggage.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢4公斤懷疑大麻花 拘28歲內地男子
zh.dek: 一名28歲內地男旅客由曼谷抵港，海關在其寄艙行李箱內發現約4公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約90萬元，男子已被捕。

en.headline: Extremely hot weather continues under Very Hot Weather Warning
en.dek: The Observatory expects mainly fine and extremely hot conditions on Tuesday, with some areas reaching 37 degrees Celsius or above under residual influence from Tropical Cyclone Dolphin.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣警告仍然生效 今日繼續極端酷熱
zh.dek: 天文台料熱帶氣旋白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響下，星期二大致天晴極端酷熱，部分地區氣溫達37度或以上。

en.headline: Uber launches first Asia-Pacific Elite premium service with Kwoon Chung
en.dek: The partnership offers pre-booked Mercedes-Benz S-Class and V-Class rides with uniformed chauffeurs, targeting business travellers and making Hong Kong the first market outside the United States to introduce the service.

zh.headline: Uber聯乘冠忠推Elite尊尚服務 成亞太首個市場
zh.dek: 乘客可經App預約平治S及V-Class豪華車，司機穿制服並完成培訓，服務涵蓋機場接送，香港為美國以外首個推出地點。

en.headline: Over 34,000 subdivided units registered under simplified-flats scheme
en.dek: Housing Secretary Winnie Ho said about 70 per cent of Hong Kong’s estimated 110,000 subdivided units need only minor works to meet minimum standards, and registration progress is satisfactory.

zh.headline: 逾3.4萬分間單位已交簡樸房登記申請 何永賢稱進度理想
zh.dek: 房屋局局長指全港約11萬個分間單位中，約七成只需小規模改動即可符合最低標準，鼓勵業主在8月31日前登記。

en.headline: Police deploy drones for first time in West Kowloon traffic enforcement
en.dek: A two-week territory-wide operation targeting careless driving and other offences began with aerial patrols along the West Kowloon Highway and Lin Cheung Road on Monday.

zh.headline: 警方西九龍公路首次出動無人機交通執法
zh.dek: 為期兩周的全港交通執法行動周一展開，西九龍總區率先於連翔道及西九龍公路以無人機空中監察，重點打擊不專注駕駛等違例。

en.headline: Hong Kong’s largest community living room opens in Tsuen Wan
en.dek: The 7,000-square-foot facility is the sixth new living room opened this year and is expected to serve about 610 subdivided-flat households, Chief Secretary Chan Kwok-ki said.

zh.headline: 全港最大社區客廳在荃灣開幕
zh.dek: 政務司司長陳國基表示，實用面積約7,000平方呎的荃灣社區客廳是今年第六間新設施，料可惠及約610個劏房戶。

en.headline: 20-month-old infant in critical condition after influenza A and septic shock
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating the case of a previously healthy boy who developed fever and convulsions; he remains in paediatric intensive care at Queen Elizabeth Hospital.

zh.headline: 20個月大男嬰染甲流併發敗血性休克危殆
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心調查一宗兒童甲型流感嚴重個案，男嬰過往健康良好，現於伊利沙伯醫院兒童深切治療部留醫，情况危殆。

en.headline: Man dies after suspected drowning at Tuen Mun’s Lam Tei Reservoir
en.dek: Firefighters recovered a man in his 30s from the water near the dam outlet on Monday afternoon; he was certified dead at the scene and police are investigating the circumstances.

zh.headline: 屯門藍地水塘男子疑遇溺不治
zh.dek: 周一午後一名年約30多歲男子在藍地水塘水壩放水口附近載浮載沉，消防救起後當場證實死亡，警方正調查身分及原因。

en.headline: Court of Appeal grants 11 defendants certificate to seek CFA leave in 35+ case
en.dek: The Court of Appeal certified five points of law of great and general importance arising from the national-security convictions linked to the 2020 democratic primary.

zh.headline: 35+案11名被告獲批終院上訴證明書
zh.dek: 上訴庭裁定五項涉及國安法及基本法預算案機制的法律議題屬廣泛及重要，批出證明書。

en.headline: Man arrested after knife attack injures domestic helper and security guard at Baguio Villa
en.dek: A man in his twenties was detained after allegedly wounding two people with a knife outside the Pok Fu Lam estate on Monday morning.

zh.headline: 碧瑤灣男子持刀傷人 外傭及保安受傷被捕
zh.dek: 周一早上薄扶林碧瑤灣發生持刀襲擊，一名外籍女傭及一名保安員受傷，警方當場拘捕涉案男子。

en.headline: Police arrest eight over compensated dating scams involving HK$6.2 million
en.dek: Officers say the suspects posed as lawyers and tycoons on social media, offering large monthly payments before demanding so-called legal fees from victims.

zh.headline: 警方拘八人涉援交詐騙涉款620萬元
zh.dek: 疑犯在社交平台出示假名片，自稱律師或富商，承諾每月支付數萬元後向事主索取所謂律師費。

en.headline: Mainland bar-restaurant chain Commune opens first Hong Kong outlet
en.dek: The flagship store at Lee Garden Three in Causeway Bay marks the start of the chain’s overseas expansion, with plans for more locations and a regional headquarters in the city.

zh.headline: 內地酒吧餐廳連鎖Commune首店進駐銅鑼灣
zh.dek: 旗艦店位於利園三期，計劃一年內再開分店，並在港設立地區總部統籌海外擴展。

en.headline: Youth membership in uniformed groups falls 8% over five years
en.dek: Home and Youth Affairs Bureau figures show total membership across 11 subsidised groups dropped from 117,671 to 108,551 between 2020-21 and 2024-25, linked to low birth rates.

zh.headline: 制服團體青年會員五年跌8% 出生率低為主因
zh.dek: 民政及青年事務局數字顯示，11個受資助制服團體會員由2020-21年11.7萬人降至2024-25年10.8萬人，十年間跌近18%。

en.headline: Food Expo and concurrent fairs open at Convention Centre from 13 August
en.dek: The HKTDC event runs five days with more than 1,850 exhibitors from over 30 countries and regions; public tickets start from HK$30 and cover multiple concurrent shows.

zh.headline: 美食博覽8月13日起會展開鑼 一票行勻多展
zh.dek: 貿發局主辦的第36屆美食博覽及同期展覽於灣仔會展舉行，超過1,850家展商參展，公眾館門票30元起。

en.headline: Six teenagers arrested after boy found unconscious in Tin Hau flat with cannabis
en.dek: Police seized a small amount of suspected cannabis and a pair of iron knuckles after a 16-year-old was discovered semi-conscious in a toilet; the six, aged 13 to 18, face drug and weapons possession charges.

zh.headline: 天后單位16歲少年暈倒 警拘6青少年檢大麻及鐵蓮花
zh.dek: 保安發現16歲少年半清醒倒卧廁所，警在單位檢獲少量懷疑大麻花及鐵蓮花，拘捕3男3女，年齡介乎13至18歲。

en.headline: Man injured in Morse Park football brawl; no arrests yet
en.dek: A 43-year-old man reported being attacked by about 11 people during an amateur match at the Wong Tai Sin pitch on Sunday evening; police classified the case as assault occasioning actual bodily harm.

zh.headline: 摩士公園足球賽變群毆 43歲男子受傷暫無人被捕
zh.dek: 黃大仙摩士公園周日晚業餘球賽發生衝突，43歲男子報稱遭約11人圍毆，左眼瘀傷、頭部流血，案件列襲擊致造成身體傷害。

en.headline: Extremely hot weather continues under Very Hot Weather Warning
en.dek: The Observatory said Tropical Cyclone Dolphin’s outer subsiding air will keep temperatures high today and tomorrow, with urban highs around 36°C and some New Territories areas reaching 37°C or above.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣警告仍然生效 極端酷熱持續
zh.dek: 天文台指熱帶氣旋白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響，今明兩日部分地區氣溫達37度或以上，市區最高約36度。

en.headline: MTR passenger’s hand trapped in train door while retrieving item from tracks
en.dek: A man suffered finger injuries on a Tseung Kwan O Line train after attempting to pick up a dropped phone near Tiu Keng Leng; the train returned to the station and staff recovered the item.

zh.headline: 港鐵乘客執路軌物品遭車門夾手 三指受傷送院
zh.dek: 一名男子周五晚在調景嶺站開出的將軍澳綫列車上，疑因手機跌落路軌伸手拾取時被車門夾住手指，列車折返車站後由救護車送院。

en.headline: Labour Department to review heat-stress warning system after amber alert on record-hot day
en.dek: Unions and a former Observatory director criticised the system for remaining at the lowest amber level throughout Sunday’s all-time high of 36.9°C; the department said it will monitor operations and consider further…

zh.headline: 破紀錄高溫僅發黃色工作暑熱警告 勞工處稱會檢視系統
zh.dek: 周日天文台錄36.9度破1884年有紀錄最高，勞工處全天只維持黃色工作暑熱警告，工會及前天文台台長批評門檻過高；處方表示會密切留意並檢視是否需進一步優化。

en.headline: Police arrest five over 19 village-house burglaries linked to illegal entrants
en.dek: A New Territories North crime unit dismantled a gang targeting quiet village houses near hillsides, with total losses of about HK$2.1 million; two suspects are alleged illegal immigrants.

zh.headline: 警拘5人涉19村屋爆竊 損失約210萬 主腦疑安排人蛇犯案
zh.dek: 新界北總區刑事總部瓦解活躍於屯門、元朗、大埔的村屋爆竊團伙，涉案19個單位總損失約210萬元，兩名疑犯懷疑非法入境。

en.headline: Customs seizes 6kg of suspected cannabis buds at airport, arrests mainland man
en.dek: A 31-year-old mainland passenger arriving from Bangkok via Singapore was arrested after officers found about 6 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds worth an estimated HK$1.1 million in his checked luggage.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢6公斤懷疑大麻花 拘31歲內地男子
zh.dek: 一名31歲內地男旅客由泰國曼谷經新加坡抵港，海關在其寄艙行李箱內發現約6公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約110萬元，男子已被控販運危險藥物罪，明日提堂。

en.headline: Lee targets September release for Hong Kong’s first five-year plan
en.dek: After a district consultation forum, the Chief Executive said the government aims to publish the plan within the third quarter and wants the subsequent Policy Address issued as soon as possible afterwards.

zh.headline: 李家超：目標9月內發表香港首份五年規劃
zh.dek: 特首出席地區諮詢會後表示，五年規劃諮詢本周五結束，政府目標於第三季即9月內發表，其後盡快公布施政報告。

en.headline: Hiker dies after collapsing on Plover Cove Reservoir Country Trail
en.dek: A 64-year-old Filipino man holding a Hong Kong identity card was found unconscious on the trail near Tai Po on Sunday afternoon and was certified dead while being airlifted; police are investigating whether heat…

zh.headline: 大埔船灣郊遊徑男子暈倒 直升機送院途中不治
zh.dek: 周日下午一名64歲持香港身份證的菲律賓籍男子於船灣淡水湖郊遊徑被發現昏迷，飛行服務隊直升機送院途中證實不治，警方調查是否與中暑有關。

en.headline: Five-year-old with chronic illness in serious condition after influenza A
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a case of influenza A (H1) complicated by sepsis; the girl, who had received the 2025/26 seasonal vaccine, remains in the paediatric intensive care unit at Tuen Mun…

zh.headline: 5歲長期病患女童染甲流併發敗血症 情况嚴重
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心調查一宗兒童甲型流感嚴重個案，女童已接種2025/26年度季節性流感疫苗，現於屯門醫院兒童深切治療部留醫，情况嚴重。

en.headline: Air-conditioner fire at Taikoo Shing sends 16 to hospital
en.dek: A suspected short-circuit in a split-type air-conditioner on the 20th floor of Begonia Mansion at Harbour View Gardens caused heavy smoke on Sunday afternoon; about 300 residents were evacuated and more than 20 waited…

zh.headline: 太古城海棠閣冷氣機起火 16人不適送院
zh.dek: 周日下午海景花園海棠閣20樓單位懷疑分體式冷氣機電線短路起火，冒出大量濃煙，約300人疏散，逾20人暫上天台，16人不適送院。

en.headline: Observatory records 36.9°C, new all-time high since 1884
en.dek: Under Severe Typhoon Dolphin’s outer subsiding air, the Hong Kong Observatory headquarters reached 36.9 degrees Celsius by mid-afternoon, while Sheung Shui hit 39.7–39.8 degrees, the highest at any automatic station…

zh.headline: 天文台錄36.9度再破有紀錄最高溫 上水見39.8度
zh.dek: 受強颱風白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響，天文台總部周日下午錄得36.9度，刷新1884年有紀錄以來最高氣溫，上水自動氣象站更高見39.7至39.8度。

en.headline: Paul Chan expects over 100 mega events in second half to draw 1.85 million visitors
en.dek: The Financial Secretary said first-half events already attracted 1.75 million participants and generated about HK$5.8 billion in spending, with retail sales rising for 14 consecutive months.

zh.headline: 陳茂波：下半年逾100項盛事料吸185萬旅客
zh.dek: 財政司司長在網誌表示，上半年盛事已吸引175萬人次參與並帶來約58億元消費，零售業總銷貨價值連升14個月。

en.headline: Police arrest 147 in triad syndicate linked to HK$600 million laundering
en.dek: A citywide operation code-named Rapidhorse dismantled an alleged triad network running drug dens and illegal gambling, with officers seizing cash, jewellery and weapons after tracing criminal proceeds through puppet…

zh.headline: O記搗三合會洗黑錢集團拘147人 涉逾6億元
zh.dek: 警方代號「捷駒」行動搗破懷疑三合會集團經營毒窟及賭檔，利用傀儡戶口清洗逾6億元犯罪得益，拘捕包括主腦在內共147人。

en.headline: Observatory records 36.8°C, hottest day since records began in 1884
en.dek: Under Severe Typhoon Dolphin’s outer subsiding air, the Hong Kong Observatory headquarters reached a new all-time high of 36.8 degrees Celsius on Sunday afternoon, while Happy Valley hit 38 degrees.

zh.headline: 天文台錄36.8度破有紀錄最高溫 跑馬地見38度
zh.dek: 受強颱風白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響，天文台總部周日下午錄得36.8度，刷新1884年有紀錄以來最高氣溫，跑馬地更高見38度。

en.headline: Lee says independent building-maintenance agency worth considering
en.dek: At the second district forum on Hong Kong’s first five-year plan and the 2026 Policy Address, the Chief Executive responded to public suggestions on housing, youth development and building repairs.

zh.headline: 李家超：獨立專業機構代辦樓宇維修值得考慮
zh.dek: 特首李家超周日率領司局長出席第二場五年規劃及2026年施政報告地區諮詢會，回應市民就房屋、青年發展及樓宇維修等建議。

en.headline: Observatory records 36.0°C, new high for the year
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory headquarters logged 36.0 degrees Celsius by early afternoon on Sunday under the influence of Severe Typhoon Dolphin’s outer subsiding air, surpassing the previous 2026 peak.

zh.headline: 天文台錄36.0度創今年新高
zh.dek: 受強颱風白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響，天文台總部周日中午前後錄得36.0度，刷新今年最高氣溫紀錄，新界多區超過37度。
